key.title: Key

AssessmentMetric.title: AssessmentMetric

AssessmentResult.description:
What the efficacy or safety lane found, in numbers a reader can check.

The metrics come from formulas; the claims are model-written and gated. The headline is composed
by code from the metrics, never by a model.

gaps.description: What could not be checked, and why. Unknown is valid.
gaps.title: Gaps

AssessmentResult.title: AssessmentResult

risk_ratio.description: Net multiplier of every adjustment to this cause.

share.description: Fraction of all failures this cause explains (low, base, high); unit 'share'.

produced_by.description: Node that wrote the claim text (a claim writer or analyst), never a gate. A gate only sets status.
produced_by.title: Produced By

DocumentInfo.description: A file the user uploaded before starting a run; the run names it by id.
DocumentInfo.title: DocumentInfo

EvidenceLedger.description:
prior -> posterior, by cause.

H = -ln(prior); each cause i gets H_i = share_i * H; adjustments multiply H_i by their
risk_ratio; posterior = exp(-sum(H_i)). The low end of every range is the pessimistic one
(a lower prior, higher risk ratios), the high end the optimistic one.
EvidenceLedger.title: EvidenceLedger

FailureMix.description:
Where a program's failure probability goes, by cause.

Taken from the stop reasons of stopped twin programs when there are enough of them, otherwise
from the literature figures in config/ledger.yaml. The ledger splits the prior's failure
budget with it, so each kind of evidence can move only the risk it speaks to.

n_stopped.description: Stopped twin programs behind the shares; 0 for literature.
n_stopped.title: N Stopped

FailureMix.title: FailureMix

direction.description: Effect on the probability of success: up lowers the cause's risk (ratio <= 1).
direction.title: Direction

pos_after.description: Probability of success after this step (low, base, high); the last step equals the posterior.

phase.description: Pipeline phase the UI groups this step under.
phase.title: Phase

cause.description: The failure cause this reason speaks to, when it is about one.
cause.title: Cause

RiskAdjustment.description:
One piece of evidence that moves one cause's risk.

Written by the assessment lanes (any node may add one) and applied by evidence_ledger:
the cause's cumulative hazard is multiplied by risk_ratio. Below 1 lowers that risk.

inputs.description: The numbers the formula used, so a reader can recompute the ratio.
inputs.title: Inputs

risk_ratio.description: Multiplier on the cause's hazard; low = optimistic, high = pessimistic.

RiskAdjustment.title: RiskAdjustment

failure_mix.description: Failure causes among the stopped twins, or the literature split.

stop_reason_categories.description: Category of each key in stop_reasons, when the source provides one. Unmapped reasons are uncategorised.
stop_reason_categories.title: Stop Reason Categories

assessments.description: The efficacy and safety lanes' results.
assessments.title: Assessments
